summary: Testing completed for Partner Dashboard KPI drill-downs and PayPal withdrawal features. Frontend: All 4 KPI cards clickable with drill-down dialogs working, Stripe/PayPal cards displayed side by side in Payouts tab, PayPal configuration UI functional.

Payout modal correctly shows method selection (Stripe/PayPal) only when both are configured via conditional rendering
PayoutRequest model in backend correctly has optional method field defaulting to 'stripe'
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: PayPal restored to partner@paypal.com for partner user after testing

Payout modal shows method selection when both Stripe and PayPal are configured.
